overlap_rule: Before appending a new row, check audited_deposits. If present, re-audit and replace the old cumulative row at merge time, preserving the former row in audit_history. Never duplicate a deposit number.
active_thread_rule: Do not load the full cumulative ledger merely to audit new records. Use this index for overlap detection; open the full ledger only when merging or when an overlapping prior row must be inspected.
